blocks.text: Iran on Tuesday dismissed a CNN report that Tehran was preparing a so-called “dirty bomb plot.” US President Donald Trump said his administration was taking the report “very seriously.” What did reports say about an Iranian attack on Washington? Tehran’s dismissal came after CNN reported on Tuesday that “Iran is developing plans to target senior Trump administration officials by detonating a so-called dirty bomb or a chemical weapon in Washington, DC,” citing multiple US intelligence sources.
